theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.78) among the top-five ranks combined with full breadth (1.0) and no crowding (0.58) suggests the trend is intact and not reflexively stretched. The trend-gate leg (validated vol/drawdown control) is the only supported edge, and this theme sits on the right side of it. Rank 2 is treated as focus, not alpha.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Crowding flag is active (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.93, the most extreme in the set). Under the guardrails this is a size-down caution rather than a fade or short, so the directional expression is limited to avoiding fresh overweight rather than a bearish call. Full breadth and trend-tag support the narrative's persistence, which is exactly why the crowding texture is a caution, not a top signal.
theses.dissent: A crowded trend can persist well beyond a 15-day window, and this flag has no basket-level forward edge; an underweight stance risks missing continued leadership.
